## How it was verified

<!-- Towel rewrites source code, so behavior-preservation evidence matters. -->

- [ ] `just ci` passes (formatting, lint, strict typing, tests).
- [ ] Coverage stays at or above the 85% gate.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests; a fixed defect has a regression fixture.
- [ ] For engine changes: the relevant hostile batteries and, if applicable,
      the ecosystem check (`just ecosystem`) still pass.
